changelog: **Matching rule engine (#1781):** new `MatchRuleSet` / `MatchRule` tables (both in `TENANT_MODELS`, enum `MatchRuleKind` = `WEIGHTED | HARD_REQUIRE | HARD_EXCLUDE`) and a nullable `User.managerId` self-relation so "never the direct manager" is expressible. The pure, client-safe `scoreMatch(mentee, mentor, ruleSet)` (`src/lib/matching/score.ts`) returns `{ score 0-100, breakdown[], blockedBy[] }` over a registry of ten dimensions (`src/lib/matching/dimensions.ts`: skills, language, field, department, university, city, timezone, capacityHeadroom — through `getMentorAvailability()` —, managerExclusion, previousPairing); weighted contributions sum to the score, and a failed hard rule zeroes it with the rule named. `normalize.ts` folds case, accents, punctuation and a short alias table (spellings only, never categories). `resolveRuleSet(orgId)` falls back to `DEFAULT_RULE_SET`, which ranks exactly as mentor-suggest did before (pinned against the old sort in `e2e/match-score.unit.spec.ts`). Nothing reads the engine yet and nothing is auto-assigned.
